purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Takamatsu City has a current official Smart Map 地番現況図 vector-tile service. A bounded anonymous tile request at the exact WUP-point tile returned labeled parcel points and unlabeled polygons. Because no stable native identity was exposed for polygon features, no sample GeoJSON was retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Japanese first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They found the official city notice, Smart Map documentation, current catalog, and current 地番現況図 TileJSON.
requestOutcomes: Official city pages, the Smart Map shell, catalog, TileJSON and one bounded z18 PBF tile were fetched anonymously with TLS verification. The TileJSON exposed layer/schema/bounds and the PBF exposed parcel labels and polygons. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, or unsafe-field request was used.
